name: Erik Wilhelm
source: Originally born in Switzerland, Erik spent his early years travelling with his family from country to country. A natural wanderer at heart, mixed with easygoing guidelines set by his parents, Erik comes off as laid back and carefree. He only recently started attending St. Dymphna's and already a peculiar group of people have taken notice of his appearance. He can often be found wandering the school campus at all hours.
